The preliminary proposal doesn't yet finalize the execution method, tax reserve, or filing timetable. Before I sign the authorization, I'd like to hear from each of you on any relevant conditions I should be aware of. Treasury, legal, and tax accounting -- please go ahead and report.

I should note the updated forecast hasn't been circulated yet, so you and the rest of the team wouldn't have seen it. We may need to either adjust the repurchase size or revisit the cash floor before proceeding.
